lines: NRJN Family Trust, an Investor Selling Shareholder, is receiving money from selling shares in the offer for sale.
Proceeds of up to ₹141.96 crore, if all offered shares are sold, have been in hand since 11 Mar 2026, 249 days ago.
Pre-offer capital shares unlocked on 9 Sep 2026, so the retained holding may be worth discussing next.
Caveat: the retained holding is unknown because the pre-offer holding is not confirmed from the documents.
